articles.title: Arizona Diamondbacks fall to Yankees, playoff hopes fading
articles.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks open a three-game series against the New York Yankees on Friday, Sept. 18, at Chase Field.

articles.title: Miami Marlins at Arizona Diamondbacks odds, picks and predictions
articles.description: The Miami Marlins and Arizona Diamondbacks meet Wednesday for the finale of their 3-game series. First pitch from Chase Field in Phoenix, Arizona, is set for 9:40 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Arizona Diamondbacks lose to Rangers, fall back in wild card race
articles.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks will look for their second win in as many days against the Texas Rangers on Saturday, Sept. 12.

articles.title: Texas Rangers at Arizona Diamondbacks odds, picks and predictions
articles.description: The Texas Rangers and Arizona Diamondbacks wrap up a three-game interleague series Sunday in Phoenix, Arizona. First pitch is set for 4:10 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Diamondbacks' Perdomo cut down at the plate in 10th. Marlins win in 11
articles.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks will look to win their second in as many days against the Miami Marlins on Tuesday night, Sept. 15.

articles.title: Diamondbacks errors costly as Rangers take series, hurt playoff hopes
articles.description: Before their series finale against the Texas Rangers, the Arizona Diamondbacks designated veteran outfielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. for assignment.

articles.title: Corbin Carroll's desperation walk-off homer rescues Diamondbacks
articles.description: With 12 games remaining in their season, the Diamondbacks open a three-game set vs. the Marlins on Monday night, Sept. 14, at Chase Field.

articles.title: Diamondbacks outfield prospect, 2024 1st-rounder, undergoes back surgery
articles.description: Diamondbacks prospect Slade Caldwell will be sidelined for four to six months after undergoing back surgery. The outfielder struggled this year in High-A Hillsboro, hitting .216 in 104 games.

articles.title: Diamondbacks' wild-card drama continues as Marlins, Yankees come to town
articles.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks wrap up their three-game, weekend series with the Texas Rangers and then host the Miami Marlins and the New York Yankees.
